description: Latest hourly ground-level ozone (O3) reading in ug/m3 at the nearest working Defra AURN monitor, plus its 8-hour mean and the Daily Air Quality Index band and health advice that mean gives. Ozone peaks on hot sunny days (summer smog), often higher in the countryside than in cities, so this suits runners and people with lung conditions in heatwaves. Source: Defra UK-AIR. Not a forecast. (cost: 1 credit)

lat.description: number, required, latitude of the place (UK, 49 to 61)

lon.description: number, required, longitude of the place (UK, -9 to 2.5)

max_km.description: number, optional, furthest monitor to use in km, default 25, max 100

name: ozone_level_near
